To reproduce panel **f** Figure 3 & panels **a, b, c, and d** from Figure 4 you need to download the data (Figure3_metaDat.csv) from the EGA repository (see Readme.txt).

## Figure 3 Panel f

```{r,echo=T,eval=T,fig.width=16,fig.height=12}
# ============================================================
# Fig3/code/panel_f_ae_volcano.R
# Panel F: volcano plot of HR estimates (OS/PFS/TST) for AE
# burden/category variables, optimal-cutpoint dichotomized, by arm.
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(rlang)
source("Figure1/00_colors.R")
source("Figure3f_Figure4abcd/03_load_data.R")   # for load_figure3_data()
source("Figure1/utils_plot_group_boxplot.R")

AE_SIGNATURES <- c(
  "Total_AEs", "n_Events_Grade_1", "n_Events_Grade_2", "n_Events_Grade3or_more",
  "Blood and lymphatic system disorders", "Endocrine disorders", "Fatigue",
  "Gastrointestinal disorders", "Metabolism and nutrition disorders",
  "Musculoskeletal and connective tissue disorders", "Nervous system disorders",
  "Renal and urinary disorders", "Respiratory, thoracic and mediastinal disorders",
  "Skin and subcutaneous tissue disorders"
)

SURV_VARS <- list(
  OS  = c("OS",  "OS_status"),
  PFS = c("PFS", "PFS_status"),
  TST = c("TST", "TST_status")
)

TLS_ARM_LIST <- c("Nivo-Ipi", "Nivo", "TKI")

# ------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Run the cutpoint analysis across every arm x endpoint combo,
# collapsing the original triple copy-pasted loop into one.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
compute_hr_results <- function(meta, vars = AE_SIGNATURES,
                               arms = TLS_ARM_LIST, surv_vars = SURV_VARS) {
  
  all_results <- lapply(names(surv_vars), function(ep) {
    time_sym  <- sym(surv_vars[[ep]][1])    # e.g. sym("OS")
    event_sym <- sym(surv_vars[[ep]][2])    # e.g. sym("OS_status")
    
    ep_results <- lapply(arms, function(z) {
      subset_clinical <- meta[meta$arm == z, ]
      
      res <- run_survival_cutpoint_analysis(
        data        = subset_clinical,
        time_col    = !!time_sym,    # correctly captured by enquo() inside the function
        event_col   = !!event_sym,
        vars        = vars,
        multivariable = FALSE,
        minprop     = 0.2,
        cut_method  = c("optimal")
      )
      
      res$results$Clinical_variable <- ep
      res$results$Arm <- z
      res$results
    })
    bind_rows(ep_results)
  })
  
  bind_rows(all_results)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Volcano plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_panel_f <- function(meta, save_rds_path = NULL) {
  
  HR_results_all <- compute_hr_results(meta)
  
  if (!is.null(save_rds_path)) saveRDS(HR_results_all, save_rds_path)
  
  df <- HR_results_all %>%
    mutate(
      logp  = -log10(P_value),
      Group2 = ifelse(P_value > 0.05, "N.S.", Arm),
      lab    = ifelse(P_value < 0.05, Variable, ""),
      shape  = case_when(
        Clinical_variable == "OS"  ~ 19,
        Clinical_variable == "PFS" ~ 15,
        Clinical_variable == "TST" ~ 17
      )
    )
  
  p_cutoff  <- 0.05
  hr_cutoff <- 1
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = HR, y = logp)) +
    ylim(0, 8) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Group2, size = Cutoff_percentile, shape = Clinical_variable), alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = volcano_arm_colors, name = "Arm group") +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "Percentile cutoff", range = c(1, 10), limits = c(0, 100),
      breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100), labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = hr_cutoff, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(df, lab != ""), aes(label = lab),
      size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", max.overlaps = 30,
      box.padding = 0.5, segment.size = 0.5
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Volcano plot HR estimates on OS, PFS & TST using AEs variables",
      subtitle = "Group comparison",
      x = "Hazard-ratio", y = expression(-log[10](p - value))
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "right", legend.box = "vertical")
}

# --- usage ---
 meta <- load_figure3_data("Figure3f_Figure4abcd/Figure3_metaDat.csv")
plot_panel_f(meta, save_rds_path = NULL)


```

## Figure 4 Panel a

```{r,echo=T,eval=T,fig.height=14,fig.width=10}
# ============================================================
# Fig4/code/panel_a_ae_grade_response.R
# Panel A: AE counts by grade (1/2/3+), split by response (R/NR)
# and arm.
# ============================================================
library(dplyr)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
source("Figure1/00_colors.R")
source("Figure3f_Figure4abcd/03_load_data.R")   # for load_figure3_data()
source("Figure1/utils_plot_group_boxplot.R")

plot_panel_a <- function(meta) {
  
  df_m <- meta %>%
    distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(n_Events_Gradeover3 = n_Events_Grade3or_more) %>%   # already collapsed upstream — see note above
    select(n_Events_Grade_1, n_Events_Grade_2, n_Events_Gradeover3, Agg_response, arm, ID) %>%
    reshape2::melt(id.vars = c("Agg_response", "arm", "ID")) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    group_by(Agg_response, arm, variable, ID) %>%
    summarise(total_value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      Grade = variable,
      value = total_value,
      Agg_response = factor(Agg_response, levels = c("R", "NR"))
    )
  
  color_groups  <- setNames(rep_2_colors, c("NR", "R"))
  color_groupsb <- setNames(adjustcolor(color_groups, alpha.f = 0.3), c("NR", "R"))
  
  ggplot(df_m[df_m$Grade != "Grade NR", ],
         aes(x = arm, y = value, color = Agg_response, shape = arm, fill = Agg_response)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
                 outlier.colour = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8,
               position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.3, jitter.height = 0, dodge.width = 0.5)) +
    theme_bw() +
    ylab("Adverse Event count") + xlab("") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "solid", color = "black"),
      axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "solid", color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0, face = "bold")
    ) +
    stat_compare_means(aes(label = after_stat(p.format)), show.legend = FALSE, method = "wilcox.test") +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_groups) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_groupsb) +
    facet_wrap(~ Grade, scales = "free", nrow = 3) +
    guides(shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 10)),
           color = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(size = 10)))
}

# --- usage ---
meta <- load_figure3_data("Figure3f_Figure4abcd/Figure3_metaDat.csv")
plot_panel_a(meta)


```

## Figure 4 Panel b

```{r,echo=T,eval=T,fig.height=14,fig.width=10}
# ============================================================
# Fig4/code/panel_b_ae_grade_tls.R
# Panel B: AE counts by grade (1/2/3+), split by TLS total
# and arm.
# ============================================================
library(dplyr)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
source("Figure1/00_colors.R")
source("Figure3f_Figure4abcd/03_load_data.R")   # for load_figure3_data()
source("Figure1/utils_plot_group_boxplot.R")

plot_panel_b <- function(meta) {
  
  # NOTE: requires AnatomicalOrigin and CollectionType columns —
  # confirm these are present in whatever metatable is passed here.
  # If Figure4_metaDat doesn't carry them, this filter step needs
  # to happen upstream at metatable-generation time instead.
  df_m <- meta %>%
    filter(AnatomicalOrigin != "lymph_node") %>%
    filter(CollectionType == "whole section") %>%
    distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(n_Events_Gradeover3 = n_Events_Grade3or_more) %>%   # already-collapsed column, as in Panel A
    select(n_Events_Grade_1, n_Events_Grade_2, n_Events_Gradeover3, TLS_total_cat, arm, ID) %>%
    reshape2::melt(id.vars = c("TLS_total_cat", "arm", "ID")) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    group_by(TLS_total_cat, arm, variable, ID) %>%
    summarise(total_value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      Grade = variable,
      value = total_value,
      TLS_total_cat = factor(TLS_total_cat, levels = c("TLS_total_Presence", "TLS_total_Absence"))
    )
  
  ggplot(df_m[df_m$Grade != "Grade NR", ],
         aes(x = arm, y = value, color = TLS_total_cat, shape = arm, fill = TLS_total_cat)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
                 outlier.colour = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8,
               position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.3, jitter.height = 0, dodge.width = 0.5)) +
    theme_bw() +
    ylab("Adverse Event count") + xlab("") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "solid", color = "black"),
      axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "solid", color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0, face = "bold")
    ) +
    stat_compare_means(aes(label = after_stat(p.format)), show.legend = FALSE, method = "wilcox.test") +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_groups_TLSb_total) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_groups_TLSb_total) +
    facet_wrap(~ Grade, scales = "free", nrow = 3) +
    guides(shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 10)),
           color = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(size = 10)))
}

# --- usage ---
meta <- load_figure3_data("Figure3f_Figure4abcd/Figure3_metaDat.csv")
plot_panel_b(meta)
```

## Figure 4 Panel c

```{r,echo=T,eval=T,fig.height=14,fig.width=10}
# ============================================================
# Fig4/code/panel_c_ae_grade_gaba.R
# Panel C: AE counts by grade, split by TLS-GABA group and arm.
# and arm.
# ============================================================
library(dplyr)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
source("Figure1/00_colors.R")
source("Figure3f_Figure4abcd/03_load_data.R")   # for load_figure3_data()
source("Figure1/utils_plot_group_boxplot.R")
GABA_LEVELS <- c("TLS positive Low_GABA", "TLS positive High_GABA", "TLS negative")

GABA_COMPARISONS <- list(
  c("TLS positive Low_GABA", "TLS positive High_GABA"),
  c("TLS positive Low_GABA", "TLS negative"),
  c("TLS negative", "TLS positive High_GABA")
)

plot_panel_c <- function(meta) {
  
  # NOTE: assumes Sampling/Site columns exist and are distinct from
  # (or aliases of) CollectionType/LesionCategory used elsewhere —
  # confirm before trusting this filter combination.
  df_m <- meta %>%
    filter(AnatomicalOrigin != "lymph_node") %>%
    filter(CollectionType == "whole section") %>%
    filter(!is.na(GABA_synthesis_group_TLS2)) %>%
    distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(n_Events_Gradeover3 = n_Events_Grade3or_more) %>%   # already-collapsed column, consistent with Panels A/B
    select(n_Events_Grade_1, n_Events_Grade_2, n_Events_Gradeover3,
           GABA_synthesis_group_TLS2, arm, ID) %>%
    reshape2::melt(id.vars = c("GABA_synthesis_group_TLS2", "arm", "ID")) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    group_by(GABA_synthesis_group_TLS2, arm, variable, ID) %>%
    summarise(total_value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      Grade = variable,
      value = total_value,
      GABA_synthesis_group_TLS2 = factor(GABA_synthesis_group_TLS2, levels = GABA_LEVELS)
    )
  
  ggplot(df_m[df_m$Grade != "Grade NR", ],
         aes(x = GABA_synthesis_group_TLS2, y = value,
             color = GABA_synthesis_group_TLS2, fill = GABA_synthesis_group_TLS2)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8, position = position_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0)) +
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = GABA_COMPARISONS, method = "wilcox.test",
                       aes(label = after_stat(p.format)), hide.ns = TRUE) +
    facet_grid(Grade ~ arm, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_groups_TLS_total_GABA) +     # solid — was incorrectly the alpha version
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_groups_TLSb_total_GABA) +     # translucent — correct as-is
    theme_bw() +
    ylab("Adverse Event count") + xlab("GABA synthesis group (TLS)") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}


# --- usage ---
meta <- load_figure3_data("Figure3f_Figure4abcd/Figure3_metaDat.csv")
plot_panel_c(meta)


```

## Figure 4 Panel d

```{r,echo=T,eval=T,fig.height=10,fig.width=22}
# ============================================================
#  Fig4/code/panel_d_ae_fc_counts.R
# Panel D: Log2 fold-change (TLS-high vs TLS-low, normalized per
# patient-in-stratum) and absolute AE counts, by arm, top-10 AE
# categories.
#============================================================
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(RColorBrewer)
source("Figure1/00_colors.R")
source("Figure3f_Figure4abcd/03_load_data.R")   # for load_figure3_data()
source("Figure1/utils_plot_group_boxplot.R")
AE_CATEGORY_COLS <- c(
  "Blood and lymphatic system disorders", "Endocrine disorders", "Fatigue",
  "Gastrointestinal disorders", "Metabolism and nutrition disorders",
  "Musculoskeletal and connective tissue disorders", "Nervous system disorders",
  "Renal and urinary disorders", "Respiratory, thoracic and mediastinal disorders",
  "Skin and subcutaneous tissue disorders"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# build_ae_counts(): verified in the prior sanity check (55/55
# rows match the original event-level ae_updated2026 exactly).
# Now also returns top_10_aes so downstream factor levels stay
# in sync with whatever list was actually used to filter.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_ae_counts <- function(meta, top_n = 10) {
  meta$TLS_status_2 <- ifelse(meta$TLS_total_cat == "TLS_total_Presence","high","low")
  stopifnot("TLS_status_2" %in% colnames(meta))
  
  base <- meta %>%
    filter(AnatomicalOrigin != "lymph_node") %>%
    filter(CollectionType == "whole section") %>%
    filter(!is.na(TLS_status_2))
  
  long <- base %>%
    select(ID, arm, TLS_status_2, all_of(AE_CATEGORY_COLS)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(AE_CATEGORY_COLS), names_to = "CTCAE_edit", values_to = "count") %>%
    filter(!is.na(count), count > 0)
  
  top_10_aes <- long %>%
    group_by(CTCAE_edit) %>%
    summarise(total_events = sum(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
    slice_max(total_events, n = top_n) %>%
    pull(CTCAE_edit)
  
  ae_counts <- long %>%
    filter(CTCAE_edit %in% top_10_aes) %>%
    group_by(arm, CTCAE_edit, TLS_status_2) %>%
    summarise(Count = sum(count), total_patients = n_distinct(ID), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Normalized_Count = Count / total_patients)
  
  list(ae_counts = ae_counts, top_10_aes = top_10_aes, filtered_base = base)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# patients_per_tls: true stratum size (arm x TLS_status_2),
# built from the SAME filtered population used in build_ae_counts
# (AnatomicalOrigin != lymph_node, CollectionType == whole section,
# TLS_status_2 non-missing) — not restricted to patients who had
# a given AE category, unlike ae_counts' own total_patients.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_patients_per_tls <- function(filtered_base) {
  filtered_base %>%
    distinct(ID, arm, TLS_status_2) %>%
    count(TLS_status_2, arm, name = "total_patients")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Panel D: fold-change + absolute-count plots
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_panel_d <- function(meta) {
  
  ae_build <- build_ae_counts(meta)
  ae_counts <- ae_build$ae_counts
  top_10_aes <- ae_build$top_10_aes
  patients_per_tls <- build_patients_per_tls(ae_build$filtered_base)
  
  ae_normalized <- ae_counts %>%
    left_join(patients_per_tls, by = c("arm", "TLS_status_2")) %>%
    mutate(Normalized_Count_New = Count / total_patients.y) %>%
    select(arm, CTCAE_edit, TLS_status_2, Count, total_patients.y, Normalized_Count_New)
  
  unique_pairs <- ae_normalized %>%
    select(arm, CTCAE_edit) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  ae_fc <- ae_normalized %>%
    select(arm, CTCAE_edit, TLS_status_2, Normalized_Count_New, Count) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = TLS_status_2, values_from = c(Normalized_Count_New, Count)) %>%
    mutate(
      Count_high = ifelse(is.na(Count_high), 0, Count_high),
      Count_low  = ifelse(is.na(Count_low),  0, Count_low),
      Normalized_Count_New_high = ifelse(is.na(Normalized_Count_New_high), 0, Normalized_Count_New_high),
      Normalized_Count_New_low  = ifelse(is.na(Normalized_Count_New_low),  0, Normalized_Count_New_low),
      FoldChange  = Normalized_Count_New_high / Normalized_Count_New_low,
      Total_Count = Count_high + Count_low
    ) %>%
    # if one class has zero counts, fold change collapses to the other class's value
    mutate(FoldChange = ifelse(is.infinite(FoldChange) | FoldChange == 0.0,
                               pmax(Normalized_Count_New_high, Normalized_Count_New_low),
                               FoldChange))
  
  stopifnot(all(unique_pairs$CTCAE_edit == ae_fc$CTCAE_edit))   # was table()==-based eyeball check; now a hard guard
  
  unique_pairs$fold_change <- ifelse(is.infinite(as.numeric(ae_fc$FoldChange)), 0, as.numeric(ae_fc$FoldChange))
  unique_pairs$Counts <- as.numeric(ae_fc$Total_Count)
  unique_pairs$CTCAE_edit <- factor(unique_pairs$CTCAE_edit, levels = rev(top_10_aes))
  unique_pairs$arm <- factor(unique_pairs$arm, levels = c("TKI", "Nivo", "Nivo-Ipi"))
  unique_pairs$log2FC <- ifelse(unique_pairs$fold_change != 0, log2(unique_pairs$fold_change), 0)
  
  p_FC2 <- ggplot(unique_pairs, aes(x = CTCAE_edit, y = log2FC, fill = arm)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-3, 3)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = arm_colors, name = "Treatment") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(log2FC, 2), hjust = ifelse(log2FC > 0, -0.5, 1)),
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), color = "black") +
    labs(title = "Log2 Fold Changes of Adverse Events between TLS-presence and TLS-absence",
         x = "Adverse Event Type", y = "Log2 Fold Change", fill = "Treatment") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18)
  
  p_Counts <- ggplot(unique_pairs, aes(x = CTCAE_edit, y = Counts, fill = arm)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-3, 3)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = arm_colors, name = "Treatment") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(Counts, 2)), hjust = -0.25,
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), color = "black") +
    labs(title = "Absolute counts of Adverse Events between All patients (n=109)",
         x = "Adverse Event Type", y = "Absolute count", fill = "Treatment") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18)
  
  ggarrange(
    p_Counts,
    p_FC2 + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank()),
    ncol = 2, nrow = 1, common.legend = TRUE, align = "h"
  )
}


# --- usage ---
meta <- load_figure3_data("Figure3f_Figure4abcd/Figure3_metaDat.csv")
plot_panel_d(meta)


```
